free.error_scope: Bounds enclose arithmetic at represented inputs. Balance errors include solved-rate representation enclosures. Local tangential constraint and constraint-power errors are fixed represented-rate evaluation bounds; these physical reactions need not vanish. No pressure/geometry/parameter uncertainty, constitutive accuracy, trajectory or material admission.
